integrity: Analytical generator proof and reproducible standalone symbolic and matrix-exponential checks are supplied; publication priority is qualified and external independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-state switching only; strictly positive trap stiffness, switching rate and diffusivity; stationary one-dimensional position data; exact population covariance derivatives and fourth moment; no noisy/finite-sample identification theorem. Earlier one-time formulas and original model are credited.
title: Exact twofold covariance aliasing and fourth-moment resolution in an intermittently trapped Brownian particle
